text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "Within two months after the conclusion of the consultation of public authorities, the SFOE petitions the Federal Council to designate the planning corridor and applicable transmission technology.", "severity": 0.8, "before": ""}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Elle comprend différentes étapes, dont celle de la consultation et de la participation durant laquelle les particuliers intéressés peuvent se prononcer.", "severity": 0.6, "before": ""}, {"side": "en", "quote": "The detailed plan is binding for the entity submitting the application, as well as for the federal, cantonal and communal authorities.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "The detailed plan in which the Federal Council defines a corridor for the transmission line project and specifies the type of transmission technology to be used (overhead lines or underground cables)."}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "La fiche d’objet a force obligatoire pour les autorités fédérales, cantonales et communales.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "La fiche d’objet, dans laquelle le Conseil fédéral détermine le corridor de planification pour la construction de la ligne électrique ainsi que la technologie de transport à utiliser (ligne aérienne ou ligne souterraine)."}]}
